name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began in his teens, tinkering with go-karts at a local track near Auckland. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he quickly climbed the ranks, starting as a junior technician for a small racing team before moving into operations management.

Rhys is known for his meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. He excels at coordinating complex logistical operations, ensuring that the team has the right resources at the right time. His approach is rooted in clear communication, fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and supported. What sets Rhys apart is his ability to anticipate potential issues and proactively implement solutions, minimizing disruptions and maximizing efficiency on and off the track.

Before Century Motorsport, Rhys worked at a smaller Formula series. He brings a wealth of experience in ensuring the team's racing operations are at peak performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee before every race.
